attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of  P. Kaniaapan as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company w.e.f. November 12, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. P. Kaniappan, DIN 02696192, as an Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director for a term of three years commencing November 12, 2026. This appointment is subject to shareholder approval by way of a special resolution. Mr. Kaniappan has over four decades of experience in the automotive industry. The company confirmed he is not debarred from holding office and is not related to any Director or Key Managerial Personnel.

attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board appointed Mr. P. Kaniappan, DIN 02696192, as Additional Director and Non-Executive Independent Director. This appointment is for a term of three years commencing November 12, 2026, and ending November 11, 2029. The appointment is subject to shareholder approval by way of a special resolution. Mr. Kaniappan has over four decades of experience in the automotive industry. He holds a bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering and a master's degree in Manufacturing Systems Engineering from the University of Warwick, UK. He also holds an Executive MBA from Great Lakes Institute of Management, Chennai. The Board confirmed he is not debarred from holding office and is not related to any Director or Key Managerial Personnel.

attchmntText: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Sharda Motor Industries Limited has scheduled a conference call to discuss operational and financial performance for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The meeting is set for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 15:00 IST. The management team includes Mr. Aashim Relan, Group CEO, Mr. Ashwani Maheshwari, DMD, and Mr. GD Takkar, Group CFO. The event covers Q2FY27 and H1FY27 post-results. Universal access numbers are +91 22 6280 1224 and +91 22 7115 8125. International toll-free numbers are available for Hong Kong, Singapore, UK, and USA. Contact persons include Mr. Mihir Vora and Mr. Ronak Jain from Equirus Securities Pvt. Ltd., and Mr. Kanav Khanna and Mr. Salman Mohammed Shiras from Ernst & Young LLP. The invite is available on the company website at www.shardamotor.com.
